author: Daniele Morais
title: Drought: alerta orange for Madagascar
subtitle: The global disaster alert system rates event "Madagascar-2026" at orange (moderate to high) level.
excerpt: Drought puts Madagascar under orange (moderate to high) alert in the international GDACS system.
contentHtml:
GDACS, the global disaster alert and coordination system run by the UN and the European Commission, issued a orange (moderate to high) alert for event "Madagascar-2026" (drought) affecting Madagascar.

From the official bulletin: The Drought notification level is Orange.

What the alert level means

GDACS rates events green, orange or red based on estimated humanitarian impact — exposed population, regional vulnerability and local response capacity.

With data from GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System).
